turn_text: Dear Senator McConnell, while you have been a Republican Senate Majority Leader, you are the biggest abuser of the Do-Nothing Congress. During Obama's presidency, you politically castrated him so badly that the only thing he could do was sign executive orders to get anything done. Ever since Reagan broke unions, Reagan cut off Social Security disability to everyone. This started the homeless problem. Reagan never raised a minimum wage. Reagan created a first of the three tax breaks for the rich, followed by George W. Bush and your gift to the billionaires, the Trump tracks break of 2017. 85% of the American corporations created stockback buy options with their tax breaks. The American corporations did not expand, did not hire, or buy anything. Today's stock market is going great only because President Trump is making a federal reserve by American corporate stock shares with taxpayers' money for the first time in U.S. history. 85% of your tax breaks went to the billionaires. How many billionaires live in Kentucky? You, Mitch McConnell, have not raised a minimum wage in 12 years. How many people in Kentucky work at minimum wage jobs? Starved a Beast was started by Reagan, abused by New Kindrick, and you, Mitch McConnell, the Republicans defund all social programs, cutting government responsibilities. Housing and urban development used to build housing for the poor, not anymore. There used to be dairy products, milk and cheese and vegetables for the poor, not anymore. You and the Republicans have not raised a federal gas tax since 1992. That's almost 30 years ago. There is no federal funding to fix the roads and bridges and help fund local public transportation. I am asking you for a nickel increase for two years. That's all. Gasoline prices are at their lowest in 15 years. All road and bridge construction work be done with union workers. You are responsible for the 2006 bill that makes the U.S. Postal Service pay future health care costs. No one has to do this. You are trying to destroy the Postal Union workers so you can privatize the U.S. Postal Service. You and the media lied to the public about the Postal Service financial problems. Only late night show comedian Stephen Colbert and Seth Meyers told the truth that the Postal Service is profitable without paying future health care costs. I want you to make legislation getting rid of the burden of paying future healthcare costs so the Postal Service becomes profitable. The U.S. Postal Services can also create bank accounts for rural America. How many Kentuckians have bank accounts in rural Kentucky? Expanding the Postal Service to help rural Kentucky and rural America is your responsibility. Do you care more about Wall Street billionaires over rural Kentuckians? I am an economic developing micro-landing proposal that specializes in small business startups. When Janet Yellen was a Federal Reserve Chairwoman, her last public speech was my plan. Not if Janet Yellen is going to be the next Treasurer's Secretary, I will send her my federal grant proposal. This can work in rural America and urban America. I have made copies of this letter for the Kentucky governor and the four major Kentucky cities, major newspapers, to have all the residents of Kentucky realize that you have to work with Democrats to move our country forward.

explicit_propositions.text: Mitch McConnell served as Republican Senate Majority Leader.
During Obama's presidency, Mitch McConnell obstructed legislative progress, forcing Obama to rely on executive orders.
Reagan did not raise the minimum wage during his presidency.
85% of recent tax breaks disproportionately benefited billionaires.
Reagan initiated the first of three major tax cuts benefiting the wealthy, followed by George W. Bush and Trump's 2017 tax break.
85% of corporate stock buybacks were funded using tax breaks provided under recent Republican administrations.
Reagan’s policies led to the reduction of Social Security disability benefits, contributing to the rise in homelessness.
Corporations did not use tax breaks to expand operations, hire workers, or invest in new assets.
The current strength of the stock market is due to federal reserve actions involving corporate stocks backed by taxpayer funds.
There is no significant number of billionaires residing in Kentucky.

assumptions.text: The speaker believes that political leaders have a moral obligation to prioritize working-class Americans over billionaire interests.
Tax policy directly determines economic outcomes like job creation, investment, and inequality.
Government fiscal decisions should reflect long-term social welfare rather than short-term elite benefit.
Legislative change is necessary to correct structural flaws in government financing mechanisms like those affecting the USPS.
The U.S. Postal Service is capable of serving broader economic functions beyond mail delivery, including banking services.
Rural communities lack access to basic financial infrastructure, which the postal system could address.
Public trust in mainstream media is low; credible truths emerge primarily from satirical or alternative sources.
Economic revitalization in rural areas requires targeted federal support and bipartisan cooperation.
Janet Yellen supports the speaker’s economic model based on her prior public endorsement.
The speaker views themselves as a legitimate expert in economic development with actionable proposals worthy of national attention.
